profile_text.body:
SoftBank Group Corp., founded in 1981 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, is a public company led by representative director, chairman, and president executive officer Masayoshi Son. According to its website, the company provides information on its corporate philosophy, vision, strategy, investor relations, business segments, group companies, and sustainability and ESG information.

The company describes itself as operating in the era of the AI revolution and presents information about the possibilities that AI brings through the efforts of its group enterprises. However, the provided data does not specify particular AI products or services offered by SoftBank Group itself.
